description: (0.5.0) Artifact.extensions is never used; only Artifact.metadata gains the link (RFC-ACDP-0022 §6–§6.1).

input.note: Run the agent against a test registry, with a client that sends the a2a-001 task (two chunks for artifactId fraud-summary) unless a scenario says otherwise.

expected.behavior: The completing chunk and every snapshot carry no https://agentcontextdistributionprotocol.io/ext/a2a/v1 entry in Artifact.extensions, and the agent adds nothing to that field.
artifactId, name, description, parts and every other metadata key are byte-identical to what the agent would emit without ACDP; only io.agentcontextdistributionprotocol/provenance is added.
A client that did not send A2A-Extensions: https://agentcontextdistributionprotocol.io/ext/a2a/v1 still receives the link in metadata.
